description: Machine-readable index of the dashboard prototyping resources. Read by the dataesr-mcp /tableaux server from GitHub; keep it in sync with README.md.

guidance.title: Prototyping conventions, data sources, common vs dedicated code, manifest
Skill /dashboard: modes init, build, critique and accessibility for tableaux dashboards
Dashboard mode init: clarify request, data source (repository or user-defined) and fields
Dashboard mode build: scaffold and implement a confirmed brief
Dashboard mode critique: read-only review of usability, data correctness, DSFR use and infrastructure fit
Dashboard mode accessibility: read-only RGAA 4 / WCAG 2.1 AA review
Skill /chart: add a Highcharts chart to a board page
Chart recipe: utils, index, ChartWrapper, states and registry

templates.title: Client board skeleton
templates.description: Routes, layouts, pages, i18n, styles and sitemap config. A reference to adapt, not a generator.
templates.notes: global-layout.tsx contains a theme button and a language selector built with DSFR JS-only attributes (data-fr-opened, aria-controls, fr-collapse); DSFR JS is not loaded, so do not copy those sections. The chart pages are not part of the skeleton; see the chart examples.

templates.title: Server router stub
templates.description: Minimal board router, one route and an .http request file.

templates.title: Board manifest JSON Schema
templates.description: Schema of board.manifest.json; the README documents the fields and an example.

components.props: ChartWrapper({ config: ChartConfig, options: HighchartsOptions, constructorType?, hideTitle?, legend?, renderData? }). ChartConfig: { id, title, description?, subtitle?, comment?, readingKey?, sources?, integrationURL?, idQuery? }

createChartOptions(type: chart type | "empty", options: Highcharts.Options): Highcharts.Options; deep-merges DSFR-token theme, axes, tooltip, legend (disabled by default), credits/exporting off, accessibility on. Axis arrays are concatenated (duplicated): assign multiple axes after the call
useChartColor(): string; used for the chart-container--<color> class
Select({ label?, size?, outline?, disabled?, multiple?, closeOnSelect?, fullWidth?, children, ... }); option/group subcomponents in the same folder
ItemFilter({ label, hint?, id?, items: FilterItem[], availableKeys?, selectedKey, onSelect, emptyLabel? }); FilterItem: { key, label, category?, count?, hint? }
RangeOfYears({ availableYears: string[], defaultYears: string[], yearsByFramework? })

chart_examples.title: Reference chart: server-computed data, options via CreateChartOptions
chart_examples.note: Structure to copy: index.tsx (useQuery + ChartWrapper + renderData), query.tsx, options.tsx returning CreateChartOptions(type, options), utils.tsx (params, renderDataTable, readingKey). Its route server/src/routes/boards/european-projects/routes/horizon-europe/overview/programs-funding/index.js computes totals and success rates. In other boards use the shared createChartOptions.

chart_examples.note: Component usage only. Do not copy its data access; a prototype's charts call the board's own server routes.
